PROPOSITION 139: Fundamental Right to Abortion was on the ballot in Arizona, 2024.

Would create a fundamental right to abortion under Arizona’s constitution; the State will not be able to interfere with this fundamental right before fetal viability unless it has a compelling reason and does so in the least restrictive way possible.

$36,786,150 was raised in support of the measure, while $1,396,537 was raised in opposition. The measure PASSED.

Ballot measure committees frequently work on multiple measures. Thus, the money displayed here as supporting or opposing a specific ballot measure may actually have been used to support or oppose other ballot measures worked on by a committee.
